# Gulf Aquaculture

> Abu Dhabi aquaculture company (founded 2023, joint venture of Emirates Consortium and Hibiscus Capital Investment) that raises native Gulf fish species from broodstock to juvenile and supplies hatchery-raised fry to farms in the UAE and the region. Approach: "Local Species in Local Waters".

Key facts:
- Operates the Balghailam Island hatchery (6,000 m²) and the Sheikh Khalifa Marine Research Centre in Umm Al Quwain, SKMRC (≈18,000 m², 14 ISO/IEC 17025 laboratories) under a 15-year lease — the largest hatchery and nursery facility in the UAE and the wider Gulf.
- On track to ship 20+ million fry to regional clients; target 20 million fry at SKMRC in 2026.
- Species: Hamour (orange-spotted grouper, Epinephelus coioides), Hamra (Malabar red snapper, Lutjanus malabaricus), Shiqra (mangrove red snapper, Lutjanus argentimaculatus), Shaari (spangled emperor, Lethrinus nebulosus), Sobaity seabream; Umm Drais under evaluation.
- 1st place, Sheikh Mansour Agriculture Award (Feb 2025); BAP certification for two assets (Mar 2026).
- Regional footprint: UAE, Oman (seabream & red snapper fry supply), Malaysia and Indonesia hatcheries with Aquagrow International.
- Contact: info@gulfaquaculture.com · 7th Floor, East Tower, Abu Dhabi Mall, P.O. Box 55345, Abu Dhabi, UAE.

## News
- [Gulf Aquaculture receives BAP certification for both its assets](https://crisdisclafani.github.io/gulf-aquaculture-experience/profile-site/gulf-aquaculture-bap-certification-2026.html) (2026-03): Balghailam Island and the Sheikh Khalifa Marine Research Centre are now certified under Best Aquaculture Practices.
- [Inside SKMRC: 14 laboratories and seven native broodstock programmes](https://crisdisclafani.github.io/gulf-aquaculture-experience/profile-site/skmrc-laboratories-native-broodstock-programmes.html) (2026-01): How the Sheikh Khalifa Marine Research Centre supports broodstock development, water-quality science and fish-health monitoring.
- [Fry supply agreement signed for Red Snapper and Seabream in Oman](https://crisdisclafani.github.io/gulf-aquaculture-experience/profile-site/red-snapper-seabream-fry-supply-agreement-oman.html) (2025-12): From December 2025 Gulf Aquaculture supplies Red Snapper and Seabream fry to a regional partner in Oman.
- [Gulf Aquaculture takes over the Sheikh Khalifa Marine Research Centre](https://crisdisclafani.github.io/gulf-aquaculture-experience/profile-site/sheikh-khalifa-marine-research-centre-15-year-concession.html) (2025-11): A 15-year concession gives Gulf Aquaculture exclusive management of the largest hatchery and nursery facility in the UAE and the wider Gulf.
- [First place at the Sheikh Mansour Agriculture Award](https://crisdisclafani.github.io/gulf-aquaculture-experience/profile-site/sheikh-mansour-agriculture-award-2025-gulf-aquaculture.html) (2025-02): Gulf Aquaculture was awarded 1st place at the Sheikh Mansour Agriculture Award in February 2025.
- [First commercial sale of Hamour fry to the local market](https://crisdisclafani.github.io/gulf-aquaculture-experience/profile-site/first-hamour-fry-sale-uae-2024.html) (2024-06): Our Balghailam Island hatchery proved the concept: native Hamour fry, produced in Abu Dhabi, sold to UAE farms.
- [Gulf Aquaculture is founded in Abu Dhabi](https://crisdisclafani.github.io/gulf-aquaculture-experience/profile-site/gulf-aquaculture-founded-abu-dhabi-2023.html) (2023-01): A joint venture between Emirates Consortium and Hibiscus Capital Investment, built on a simple idea: aquaculture designed for this region.
